about.title: Your connection to opportunities in Venezuela.
about.body:
Nexport Global C.A. is a Venezuela-based company focused on developing international business relationships across key industries.

We combine local market insight with a global perspective to identify opportunities, connect businesses, and build lasting commercial partnerships.

point1.text: Understanding Venezuela’s business environment and market opportunities.

point3.title: Long-Term Focus

experienceAreas.title: Experience across the industries that move Venezuela forward.
experienceAreas.intro: Our business background spans logistics, international trade, agriculture, infrastructure, and industrial activities. This broad perspective helps us understand the needs of different sectors of the Venezuelan economy.

logistics.title: Logistics, Import & Distribution
logistics.text: Commercial experience involving international sourcing, transportation, import activities, and distribution.

agriculture.title: Agriculture & Storage
agriculture.text: Familiarity with agricultural operations, grain storage, silos, and infrastructure supporting agricultural production.

irrigation.title: Irrigation & Agricultural Technology
irrigation.text: Experience with irrigation systems, agricultural machinery, and technologies supporting productive farming operations.

oil.title: Oil & Industrial Equipment
oil.text: Business experience related to heavy equipment and the operational needs of Venezuela’s oil and industrial sectors.

howWeWork.title: Built for meaningful business relationships.
howWeWork.intro:
Successful international business begins with understanding the market, identifying the right opportunities, and building relationships through clear communication and shared goals.

We focus on developing commercial connections with long-term potential.

group.title: Family roots. A long-term vision.
group.body:
Nexport Global C.A. is part of the Ouro Branco Group, a family business group with approximately 30 years of history in Venezuela.

Over the decades, the group has developed experience in agriculture, grain storage, logistics, and other productive sectors.

This heritage provides a foundation of local market knowledge and a long-term approach to business.

As a distinct company within the group, Nexport Global focuses on developing new commercial opportunities and international connections.
